> Blog · Pipeliners · 2026-09-19

# Summary
Supporting blog for the Wave 1 and 2 city pages. Sources: `blog-drafts\clay-sewer-pipe-draft-2026-09-19.md` (the draft) and the build folder `blog-clay-sewer-pipe\` (build script, featured card, FAQ JSON-LD, post content, SEO entry for the post-seo-meta mu-plugin, images).

# Key facts
- **Focus keyphrase:** clay sewer pipe (1,223/mo US, KD 21, informational). Secondary used naturally: clay sewer line, clay pipe joints, roots in clay pipe, lining a clay sewer line.
- **SEO title:** Clay Sewer Pipe: Problems and No-Dig Fixes | Pipeliners. **H1:** Clay Sewer Pipe: Common Problems and How to Fix It Without Digging. Meta ends with the 480-535-6503 call line.
- **Author:** Jake Shaker. Cannibalization check on Sep 19 found no page targeting the phrase.
- **Status:** published as post 18150 on Sep 18 (per the handoff; folder dates follow Philippine time). Later a 24/7 mention was removed (`fix-backups\2026-10-13_sewer-scope\18150-before-rm247.html`) and the cast iron work touched it (`2026-09-26_cast-iron`).
